t_advice_summary_textbox.text: each pair of colours has one option which will give more mushrooms - choose at random to start to get a feel for the answer, then use the information to inform decision-making as the exercise progresses. The colours work in a cycle, and the pattern will cycle through colours.

vb_textbox.text: You will be shown a pair of gnomes - one gnome out of this pair will earn you more mushrooms. The gnomes will always be shown in the same coloured pairs (e.g pink shown with green). To start, choose random gnomes to identify the pattern and work out which gnome earns more points, then continue choosing this one. However - be aware that at any point the gnomes can swap (so a gnome colour previously earning you lots of points can switch to earn you few) - identify this, and then select the gnome of the opposite colour.
